title: Bigin search cannot find records where a field is empty
symptoms: [400] One of the expected parameter is missing: criteria,email,phone,word
cause: The search API has no operator for empty values.
fix: Search a recent window, for example on Created_Time, and filter for the empty field in your own code.
apply: GET /bigin/v2/Pipelines/search?criteria=(Created_Time:greater_than:2026-09-15T00:00:00+00:00), then keep records where the field is null
